verdict.rationale: Termius docs confirm an AI feature that converts plain-language descriptions into shell commands, showing some AI-assisted delegation of a narrow task, but there's no evidence of a fuller AI assistant capable of executing multi-step tasks, running snippets autonomously, or handling broader delegated work. Missing for 10: evidence of autonomous multi-step task execution, broader assistant scope beyond command generation, and independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI feature's reliability.
